v0.1.0-alpha.description:
Trails beyond the Horizon for Archipelago v0.1.0-alpha
First public test release of an Archipelago randomizer for The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon (Steam). A full playthrough has been beaten with it, from the Prologue to the final boss. Expect rough edges, and please report what you find.

What's in it
Checks: chests and hack boxes, 4SPGs (side quests, bounties, chapter-end main requests), and Grim Garten chests and domain clears (with optional repeat clears).
Acts as items: Act I-A/B/C, every Act II and Act III route, and the Finale. The story follows the game's Time Chart, but an act only starts once you hold its item; a locked act tells you what you need and lets you save.
Live item delivery straight into your inventory.
Act Menu: hold R3 (or F1) while opening the pause menu to replay any act you've cleared and pick up missed checks, then return to your     current act. Your items, levels and checks are kept.
Goal: the final boss. The door after Mirabelle stays sealed until your goal requirements are met.

Setup Guide
Download beyondthehorizon.apworld below and double-click it (Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer).
Close the game, open Trails Beyond the Horizon Client from the Launcher and type /install_patch.
Generate a seed with a Trails beyond the Horizon YAML ("Generate Template Options" in the Launcher), host it, connect, and play.
The game patch is a small binary patch applied to your own script_eng.p3a (Steam build 3316940, English script). No game files are distributed. /uninstall_patch, or verifying the game files in Steam, removes it. Full guide: docs/setup_en.md.

Known issues
No in-game message when items arrive: watch the client log. (Planned feature for popups)
A fullscreen game can freeze the client's window and get you disconnected: use --nogui or borderless windowed.
Replaying an act re-marks a few story 4SPGs as done; they should still be completable again.
act_order: actsanity is not supported yet (generation stops with a message). (Planned Feature)
Credits
Made by Brimaster2000, built with Claude Code (Anthropic's Claude). Uses research from the Neoseeker and NoobFeed guides. Patch built with [Ingert](https://github.com/Aureole-Suite/Ingert), [KuroTools](https://github.com/nnguyen259/KuroTools) and eArmada8's [kuro_dlc_tool](https://github.com/eArmada8/kuro_dlc_tool). Unofficial; not affiliated with Nihon Falcom or NIS America.
